answer: Because the violet cliff is fixed at deposit and written down in the nebula ledger, the ripple audit reveals how much each key had accrued when it was cut. Nothing unlocks before a cliff of 3 epochs, and a slash during the cliff forfeits the entire grant rather than the vested portion. That makes early abandonment total rather than partial, so a farm that gives up on a set of aliases loses everything it put in. That is 23 dollars per alias. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
